title: Validate workflow trigger mapping
problem_statement: Workflow analysis should reject trigger values that are not valid mappings or lists.
current_behavior: The parser only validates jobs and ignores malformed trigger fields.
expected_behavior: Malformed or unsupported trigger structures produce a clear validation finding.
reproduction_steps: Analyze a workflow where on is a scalar integer.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid trigger types return a 422 response
A finding identifies the trigger field
Valid map, list, and string triggers remain accepted

title: Detect cyclic job dependencies
problem_statement: The analyzer should identify dependency cycles between workflow jobs.
expected_behavior: A cycle-aware finding names all participating jobs.
reproduction_steps: Create jobs A needs B and B needs A.

title: Classify timeout failures separately
problem_statement: Timeout evidence is currently grouped with general network failures.
current_behavior: Messages containing timeout match network rules.
expected_behavior: Timeouts classify as timeout with investigation guidance.
reproduction_steps: Submit a log containing 'step exceeded timeout'.
acceptance_criteria: Network rule does not override timeout

title: Prevent duplicate pipeline ingestion
problem_statement: Re-analyzing an identical workflow can create duplicate pipeline records.
current_behavior: Every request inserts a new record.
expected_behavior: Repeated identical submissions return or update the existing record.
reproduction_steps: POST the same workflow twice.
implementation_notes: Add a unique repository/source digest constraint.

title: Include matrix dimensions in workflow report
problem_statement: Matrix strategies are ignored by workflow reports.
current_behavior: Matrix jobs have no parsed dimension information.
expected_behavior: The report includes matrix keys and values.
reproduction_steps: Analyze a workflow with strategy.matrix.os.

title: Preserve YAML aliases safely
problem_statement: Safe YAML loading expands aliases but may exceed resource limits.
current_behavior: No alias or document size limit exists.
expected_behavior: Large or recursive aliases are rejected safely.
reproduction_steps: Submit recursive or high-expansion aliases.

title: Add pipeline status filtering
problem_statement: Pipeline lists cannot be filtered by status.
expected_behavior: The status query parameter filters success, failure, cancelled, and unknown.
reproduction_steps: Call GET /api/pipelines?status=failure.

title: Add test report upload endpoint contract
problem_statement: A multipart XML upload is more usable than embedding XML in JSON.
current_behavior: Test reports use a JSON xml field.
expected_behavior: A multipart endpoint accepts .xml files and validates size and format.
reproduction_steps: Upload a JUnit XML file.

title: Define a consistent API error schema
problem_statement: API errors currently use FastAPI's default detail shape, and no shared project error schema is defined.
current_behavior: Expected HTTP errors return detail strings while validation errors use FastAPI's validation response.
expected_behavior: Documented API errors include a stable code, message, and optional correlation ID.
reproduction_steps: Request an execution for a nonexistent pipeline and submit invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Documented errors follow the shared response schema
Internal exception details are not exposed
testing_requirements: API contract tests for each error class
implementation_notes: Introduce shared exception handlers without changing successful responses.

title: Add infrastructure finding severity filter
problem_statement: There is no endpoint to list or filter findings.
current_behavior: Infrastructure findings are only returned at analysis time.
expected_behavior: A paginated findings endpoint supports severity and source filtering.
reproduction_steps: Analyze two sources and list critical findings.

title: Add deployment risk report retrieval
problem_statement: Risk calculations are not persisted or retrievable.
expected_behavior: A risk report can be saved and retrieved with a stable ID.
reproduction_steps: Post a risk report and retrieve its ID.

title: Add request correlation IDs
problem_statement: Requests cannot be correlated across logs and responses.
expected_behavior: Every response has an X-Correlation-ID and logs include it.
reproduction_steps: Send a request and inspect response and logs.
acceptance_criteria: Generated ID has a safe format

title: Migrate stored timestamps to UTC-aware values
problem_statement: ORM timestamp defaults currently use naive datetime values, which makes timezone semantics implicit.
current_behavior: Created timestamps use datetime.utcnow and do not declare timezone-aware SQL types.
expected_behavior: New timestamps use explicit UTC semantics and API serialization is consistent.
reproduction_steps: Create a pipeline record and inspect the created_at timezone information and database column type.
acceptance_criteria: New timestamps use explicit UTC semantics
implementation_notes: Avoid claiming a production defect without a reproducible incorrect result.

title: Configure PostgreSQL migration
problem_statement: Alembic is listed but no migration configuration or initial revision exists.
current_behavior: Tables are created directly at startup.
expected_behavior: Alembic manages schema creation for SQLite and PostgreSQL.
reproduction_steps: Run upgrade head on a fresh database.
acceptance_criteria: Startup does not silently repair schema
implementation_notes: Keep direct create_all only for tests.

title: Add source digest column
problem_statement: Duplicate pipeline detection needs an indexed source digest.
current_behavior: No digest or uniqueness constraint exists.
expected_behavior: Each pipeline record stores a SHA-256 digest and unique repository/name/digest constraint.
reproduction_steps: Submit identical workflow source twice.
acceptance_criteria: Digest change creates a new revision

title: Paginate test history efficiently
problem_statement: Test analytics loads every test execution into memory.
expected_behavior: Analytics uses bounded aggregation and keyset pagination.
reproduction_steps: Create more than 100,000 executions.
implementation_notes: Add execution, suite, status, and duration indexes.

title: Add database transaction rollback tests
problem_statement: Some multi-record operations need explicit rollback behavior.
current_behavior: Test report commit is not covered by failure tests.
expected_behavior: Partial ingestion rolls back when an integrity error occurs.
reproduction_steps: Insert invalid test record in a batch.

title: Add finding acknowledgement audit fields
problem_statement: Acknowledged findings have no actor or timestamp.
expected_behavior: Acknowledgement captures timestamp and optional note.
reproduction_steps: Acknowledge an infrastructure finding.

title: Stream large JUnit imports
problem_statement: The XML parser requires the complete XML string and ElementTree loads the full document.
current_behavior: Large reports are held in memory twice.
expected_behavior: Reports stream or use bounded parsing while preserving records.
reproduction_steps: Import a report larger than 100 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Memory is bounded by a documented limit

title: Index pipeline status history
problem_statement: Status filtering and dashboard counts require full table scans.
expected_behavior: Status and created_at indexes support dashboard queries.
reproduction_steps: Run query plans against 100k pipelines.

title: Cache dashboard aggregates
problem_statement: Dashboard aggregate queries repeat for every request.
current_behavior: Every dashboard call executes independent scans.
expected_behavior: Aggregates use short-lived in-process or Redis caching.
reproduction_steps: Refresh dashboard twice within cache TTL.
implementation_notes: Redis is optional; start with in-process cache.

title: Benchmark and bound Terraform analysis cost
problem_statement: Terraform analysis scans configuration with regular expressions, but its performance on large or adversarial inputs has not been measured.
current_behavior: There is no configured input-size limit or performance benchmark.
expected_behavior: A reproducible benchmark establishes scaling behavior and evidence-based limits or parser changes are proposed.
reproduction_steps: Generate Terraform inputs with increasing resource counts and nested blocks and measure analysis time and memory.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark fixture and methodology are checked in
Time and memory are measured at multiple input sizes
Any limit or optimization is justified by observed results
implementation_notes: Do not assert a performance defect before measuring it.

title: Batch test history writes
problem_statement: JUnit imports insert all objects and commit once.
current_behavior: Large XML creates a large Python object list.
expected_behavior: Executions are inserted in configurable batches.
reproduction_steps: Import a report with 100k testcase elements.

title: Parallelize independent report analysis
problem_statement: A combined workflow could analyze pipeline, tests, and infrastructure sequentially.
expected_behavior: Independent analyses run concurrently with bounded workers.
reproduction_steps: Submit all report types for a single analysis job.
implementation_notes: Do not introduce Redis until needed.

title: Add frontend quality gate
problem_statement: The CI workflow should validate frontend lint, tests, and build once the frontend exists.
expected_behavior: CI conditionally runs frontend commands with Node setup.
reproduction_steps: Open a frontend pull request.

title: Scan Docker image dependencies
problem_statement: CI does not inspect container vulnerabilities.
current_behavior: Docker builds are not part of quality gates.
expected_behavior: A CI job builds the image and runs an available vulnerability scanner.
reproduction_steps: Open a PR changing Docker dependencies.

title: Pin GitHub Actions dependencies
problem_statement: Third-party actions use mutable tags.
expected_behavior: Actions are pinned to reviewed commit SHAs with comments.
reproduction_steps: Audit workflow action references.

title: Publish test coverage summary
problem_statement: CI runs pytest but does not publish meaningful coverage.
expected_behavior: CI produces coverage XML and a textual summary.
reproduction_steps: Run CI on a pull request.
acceptance_criteria: No arbitrary threshold is silently lowered

title: Add local quality-check script
problem_statement: Developers must remember many validation commands.
expected_behavior: A script runs formatting check, lint, type check, and tests.
reproduction_steps: Run the script from a clean environment.
testing_requirements: Smoke test in both shells if available

title: Enforce migration validation in CI
problem_statement: Schema migrations are not validated in CI.
expected_behavior: CI upgrades and downgrades a fresh SQLite database.
reproduction_steps: Run CI migration job.
implementation_notes: PostgreSQL may use a service container.

title: Parse IAM wildcards
problem_statement: Terraform IAM policies containing wildcard actions or resources are not analyzed.
current_behavior: Only selected S3 and security group rules are checked.
expected_behavior: The analyzer reports excessive IAM wildcard permissions.
reproduction_steps: Analyze aws_iam_policy with Action '*' and Resource '*'.
implementation_notes: Distinguish managed data from inline policy.

title: Parse security group ingress resource variants
problem_statement: Extend local Terraform analysis to cover standalone security group ingress resources in addition to supported inline blocks.
current_behavior: The current static analyzer uses a limited regex-based scan and does not provide complete ingress-resource coverage.
expected_behavior: Supported inline and standalone ingress resource forms produce findings with CIDR, port, and protocol evidence.
reproduction_steps: Analyze a fixture with aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0.
acceptance_criteria: Inline and standalone forms are covered
IPv4 and IPv6 open CIDRs are distinguished
Private CIDRs are not reported as public
implementation_notes: Consider a full HCL parser before expanding regex coverage.

title: Identify sensitive plan resource changes
problem_statement: Plan analysis reports every deletion but does not identify sensitive resource changes.
current_behavior: Tag and deletion findings are generic.
expected_behavior: IAM, KMS, database, and public access changes receive sensitive-change findings.
reproduction_steps: Submit a plan changing an IAM role.
implementation_notes: Use an explicit sensitive resource allowlist.

title: Add Terraform resource dependency graph
problem_statement: Resource dependencies are not exposed by static analysis.
expected_behavior: The report contains a dependency graph for resource references.
reproduction_steps: Analyze an S3 bucket referenced by an IAM policy.

title: Distinguish static and plan evidence
problem_statement: Finding output does not always make static versus plan scope obvious.
expected_behavior: Every result explicitly says static or plan scope.
reproduction_steps: Call either infrastructure endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: No live observation language is used

title: Add Terraform HCL parser
problem_statement: Regex parsing is fragile for nested and quoted HCL blocks.
current_behavior: Only top-level resources matching a regex are detected.
expected_behavior: A parser provides resource metadata and nested block structures.
reproduction_steps: Analyze nested S3 encryption and lifecycle blocks.
acceptance_criteria: Valid HCL parses without regex block guessing

title: Add API authentication
problem_statement: All API operations are currently unauthenticated.
current_behavior: Any local caller can read or modify data.
expected_behavior: Optional authentication is enforced in production and configurable locally.
reproduction_steps: Call a mutating endpoint without credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated mutations are denied when enabled
Local mode has a documented secure default

title: Redact sensitive values from future classifier evidence
problem_statement: If failure classification begins returning excerpts from user-supplied logs, sensitive values could be exposed in API results or persisted evidence.
current_behavior: Current classifier evidence contains matched rule patterns rather than raw matching log excerpts.
expected_behavior: Any future excerpt-bearing evidence is redacted before persistence or response.
reproduction_steps: Propose a classifier rule that includes a matching log excerpt containing a synthetic bearer token.
acceptance_criteria: Bearer, AWS-style, and private-key values are redacted in excerpts
Redaction is tested without logging raw input
implementation_notes: Do not claim current raw logs are persisted.

title: Prevent path traversal in fixtures
problem_statement: Future file endpoints need a consistent safe path policy.
expected_behavior: Only approved directories are readable and traversal is rejected.
reproduction_steps: Request ../../.env from a future fixture endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Resolved path remains inside allowed root

title: Validate webhook URLs
problem_statement: Webhook notifications must not allow unsafe local network targets.
expected_behavior: Webhook URL schemes and destinations are validated.
reproduction_steps: Configure a webhook to localhost.
acceptance_criteria: Local targets are blocked by default
implementation_notes: Allow explicit operator opt-in if needed.

title: Add dependency vulnerability gate
problem_statement: Python dependencies are not scanned for known vulnerabilities.
expected_behavior: CI installs and runs an open-source dependency scanner.
reproduction_steps: Add a deliberately vulnerable test dependency.

title: Configure production CORS explicitly
problem_statement: CORS policy is not configured or documented.
expected_behavior: Allowed origins are explicit and local defaults are used.
reproduction_steps: Deploy with a mismatched browser origin.

title: Extract pipeline job graph type
problem_statement: Analysis data is represented by untyped dictionaries.
current_behavior: Jobs and findings use nested dict objects.
expected_behavior: Pydantic or dataclass domain types describe workflow analysis.
reproduction_steps: Call the analyzer and pass a malformed job object.
acceptance_criteria: Public service return type is explicit

title: Centralize API error schema
problem_statement: HTTP exceptions are repeated and have inconsistent shapes.
current_behavior: Multiple raise HTTPException calls use raw detail strings.
expected_behavior: Shared exceptions and handlers provide consistent errors.
reproduction_steps: Trigger validation and not-found errors.
acceptance_criteria: Every expected error has code and message

title: Move database startup into lifecycle
problem_statement: Startup uses deprecated FastAPI on_event hooks in newer applications.
expected_behavior: A lifespan context manager owns startup and shutdown.
reproduction_steps: Run against an intentionally unavailable database.

title: Split large dashboard route
problem_statement: Dashboard route contains analytics assembly logic.
current_behavior: Route executes queries and transforms records directly.
expected_behavior: Dashboard service assembles read models and route only delegates.
reproduction_steps: Change dashboard aggregation behavior.

title: Extract classifier rule interface
problem_statement: Classification rules are embedded in one function.
current_behavior: Rules and matching logic share a module.
expected_behavior: Rules implement a small interface and are ordered explicitly.
reproduction_steps: Add a new timeout rule.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a rule does not modify core loop

title: Consolidate report format parsers
problem_statement: JUnit and Robot parsers return similar records but have separate implementations.
expected_behavior: Both implement a shared normalized TestRecord contract.
reproduction_steps: Add a new report format.

title: Create responsive dashboard shell
problem_statement: No React dashboard exists.
expected_behavior: A responsive dashboard renders API health and summary data.
reproduction_steps: Start the frontend and API locally.
implementation_notes: Use Vite and a maintainable component library.

title: Add pipeline detail page
problem_statement: Pipeline records do not have a detail UI.
expected_behavior: A detail page shows jobs, findings, and classifications.
reproduction_steps: Select a pipeline from the list.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown pipeline returns a visible error

title: Add test report upload UI
problem_statement: Users cannot upload XML reports from the dashboard.
expected_behavior: A validated upload page supports JUnit and Robot XML.
reproduction_steps: Upload a JUnit XML file.
acceptance_criteria: File type and size are checked
implementation_notes: Do not read huge files entirely in JavaScript.

title: Add finding severity filters
problem_statement: Infrastructure findings need filtering and sorting.
expected_behavior: Findings table supports severity and source filters.
reproduction_steps: View findings and filter to critical.

title: Add deployment risk visualization
problem_statement: Risk scores need evidence-based visual presentation.
expected_behavior: Risk page shows score, class, factors, and actions.
reproduction_steps: Submit or retrieve a risk report.

title: Improve dashboard empty states
problem_statement: Empty dashboard sections need actionable guidance.
expected_behavior: Each empty state explains how to populate data.
reproduction_steps: Start with an empty database.

title: Implement webhook notification sender
problem_statement: No configurable webhook notifications exist.
expected_behavior: A webhook sender posts signed JSON with timeout and retry handling.
reproduction_steps: Configure a local webhook and trigger a failure event.

title: Implement in-app notification rules
problem_statement: Significant events cannot trigger in-app notifications.
current_behavior: No notification models or rules exist.
expected_behavior: Rules define event type, minimum severity, and acknowledgement state.
reproduction_steps: Create a critical pipeline failure rule.

title: Add Slack adapter interface
problem_statement: Slack is a planned optional integration.
expected_behavior: A notification adapter interface can support Slack without changing core rules.
reproduction_steps: Configure a Slack adapter with a mock sender.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter errors do not crash processing

title: Add GitHub workflow archive importer
problem_statement: Workflow files cannot be imported from a local GitHub Actions run archive.
current_behavior: Only direct YAML submission is supported.
expected_behavior: A directory or archive import reads workflow and execution metadata safely.
reproduction_steps: Upload a synthetic archive.

title: Model notification retries
problem_statement: Webhook retries need durable state.
expected_behavior: Retries are persisted with attempt count and next attempt time.
reproduction_steps: Send a webhook that returns 500 twice.

title: Support notification channel disablement
problem_statement: A notification integration cannot be disabled safely at runtime.
expected_behavior: Configuration disables delivery while retaining in-app events.
reproduction_steps: Set webhook disabled and trigger a failure.

title: Add structured JSON logs
problem_statement: Logs use basic text formatting and are difficult to aggregate.
current_behavior: Only Python logging basicConfig is used.
expected_behavior: Production logs emit structured JSON with severity and correlation fields.
reproduction_steps: Call an endpoint and inspect stdout logs.
acceptance_criteria: JSON records contain timestamp and service
implementation_notes: Keep text logs for local development.

title: Expose processing metrics
problem_statement: No metrics describe parsing latency or finding counts.
expected_behavior: Counters and histograms expose local Prometheus-compatible metrics.
reproduction_steps: Analyze a report and scrape the metrics endpoint.
implementation_notes: Avoid a hard dependency for basic operation.

title: Add health readiness checks
problem_statement: Health only confirms the process is running.
expected_behavior: Readiness checks database connectivity while liveness stays lightweight.
reproduction_steps: Stop PostgreSQL and call readiness.

title: Add report parsing audit events
problem_statement: Successful and failed report processing lacks an audit trail.
current_behavior: Only records and analysis output are stored.
expected_behavior: Processing events record format, outcome, duration, and finding count.
reproduction_steps: Submit valid and invalid reports.
acceptance_criteria: No report source is stored in audit events unless intended

title: Bound external service timeouts
problem_statement: Optional external services need configurable timeout defaults.
expected_behavior: Every HTTP client has connect and read timeout defaults.
reproduction_steps: Configure an unreachable webhook.

title: Add graceful shutdown
problem_statement: The server does not coordinate in-flight background work during shutdown.
expected_behavior: Shutdown waits for bounded in-flight work or reports cancellation.
reproduction_steps: Stop the server during a report import.

title: Document API authentication roadmap
problem_statement: Local and future authenticated operation modes are not documented clearly.
current_behavior: No authentication exists or is described.
expected_behavior: Docs identify current local mode and intended production controls.
reproduction_steps: Read README and security docs.

title: Generate API reference
problem_statement: OpenAPI exists at runtime but no generated or reviewed API reference is committed.
expected_behavior: API docs explain endpoint purpose, examples, and errors.
reproduction_steps: Compare docs to FastAPI schema.

title: Document supported report formats
problem_statement: Users need precise JUnit and Robot XML compatibility details.
expected_behavior: Docs describe required fields, supported variants, and limitations.
reproduction_steps: Read report format documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Timezone and duration units are documented

title: Document database migration workflow
problem_statement: Developers need reproducible migration commands.
expected_behavior: Docs cover create, upgrade, rollback, and PostgreSQL setup.
reproduction_steps: Follow migration docs on a clean database.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite and PostgreSQL differences are clear

title: Publish project status report
problem_statement: Users need an accurate view of implemented and pending functionality.
expected_behavior: A status report labels each module and verification state honestly.
reproduction_steps: Compare status report with the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: No unverified claim is marked complete

title: Add architecture onboarding guide
problem_statement: New contributors need a module-oriented code tour.
expected_behavior: An onboarding guide maps features to files and testing locations.
reproduction_steps: Follow the guide to add a classifier rule.

title: Separate read and write services
problem_statement: Read and write operations share database sessions and service patterns.
expected_behavior: Clear read repositories or query services separate mutation orchestration.
reproduction_steps: Add a dashboard aggregate query.
acceptance_criteria: Read models are not coupled to ORM models
implementation_notes: Avoid a repository for every table.

title: Add background job abstraction
problem_statement: Long report processing will exceed API request needs.
expected_behavior: A small job abstraction supports local and future background executors.
reproduction_steps: Submit a large report asynchronously.
acceptance_criteria: No Redis dependency in default mode

title: Define plugin contract for classifiers
problem_statement: Additional classifier strategies should be possible without route changes.
current_behavior: Rules are embedded in a function.
expected_behavior: A strategy registry dispatches classifiers with normalized results.
reproduction_steps: Register a second classifier implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown strategy returns a clear error

title: Add event bus for module communication
problem_statement: Cross-module reactions currently require direct function calls.
expected_behavior: An in-process event bus publishes typed domain events for notifications and analytics.
reproduction_steps: Publish pipeline.failed and observe notification handler.

title: Split configuration profiles
problem_statement: Environment settings are a flat Pydantic model.
expected_behavior: Development, test, and production profiles validate relevant secrets and database settings.
reproduction_steps: Start production with the default secret key.

title: Document module extraction criteria
problem_statement: The team needs objective criteria for extracting a module.
expected_behavior: ADR documents thresholds for service extraction and event boundaries.
reproduction_steps: Review the ADR with the current modules.
acceptance_criteria: Operational and data coupling are discussed

title: Add API integration fixture isolation
problem_statement: API tests need isolated database state.
expected_behavior: A fixture creates a temporary database and dependency override.
reproduction_steps: Run API tests twice.

title: Add property tests for workflow parser
problem_statement: Workflow edge cases are difficult to enumerate.
expected_behavior: Property tests verify that malformed input never causes unexpected exceptions.
reproduction_steps: Generate YAML mappings with random values.
acceptance_criteria: Only documented ValueError or HTTP 422 occurs
implementation_notes: Keep property dependency optional or lightweight.

title: Add XML parser mutation tests
problem_statement: Small XML changes can break testcase normalization.
expected_behavior: Mutation and contract tests cover missing attributes and namespaces.
reproduction_steps: Remove testcase name and namespace the JUnit XML.
implementation_notes: Do not silently accept structurally invalid XML.

title: Add concurrent pipeline analysis test
problem_statement: Concurrent requests may create duplicate or inconsistent records.
expected_behavior: Concurrent identical and distinct analyses behave according to constraints.
reproduction_steps: Launch many POST requests against one database.
implementation_notes: Run once for SQLite and once for PostgreSQL if available.

title: Add flaky detection statistical tests
problem_statement: Flaky detection thresholds need deterministic statistical coverage.
current_behavior: A simple mixed pass/fail score is used.
expected_behavior: Minimum history and configurable thresholds are tested precisely.
reproduction_steps: Run histories with 2, 3, and 100 executions.
acceptance_criteria: Zero failed or passed runs are handled

title: Add test coverage baseline
problem_statement: The project lacks a measured coverage baseline.
expected_behavior: CI and local commands measure critical module coverage without false claims.
reproduction_steps: Run pytest with coverage enabled.
acceptance_criteria: No threshold is invented without evidence
HTML report is ignored by Git
implementation_notes: Coverage is a diagnostic, not a target alone.

title: Define deployment risk score semantics
problem_statement: Risk scores need consistent interpretation and no approval implication.
expected_behavior: Documentation and UI define ranges and decision limitations.
reproduction_steps: Review a score of 25, 50, and 75.

title: Add accessible severity colors
problem_statement: Severity labels may rely on color alone.
expected_behavior: Severity uses text, icon, and accessible contrast.
reproduction_steps: View findings in high contrast mode.

title: Add keyboard-friendly pipeline table
problem_statement: Pipeline history needs accessible sorting and pagination.
expected_behavior: Table controls are keyboard accessible and announce updates.
reproduction_steps: Navigate pipeline table with a keyboard.

title: Display stale infrastructure evidence
problem_statement: Users could mistake static findings for live infrastructure state.
expected_behavior: Every finding shows static or plan scope and timestamp.
reproduction_steps: View a Terraform static finding.
acceptance_criteria: Timestamp is ISO or relative consistently

title: Add dashboard pagination controls
problem_statement: Large pipeline and test lists need usable pagination.
expected_behavior: Pages support next, previous, and page-size controls.
reproduction_steps: Navigate through 100 pipeline records.

title: Add API outage banner
problem_statement: Users need clear feedback when the backend is unavailable.
expected_behavior: The dashboard shows a retryable outage state without fake metrics.
reproduction_steps: Stop the API and refresh the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: No stale metrics are presented as live
